Analyze your data with ![](/images/galaxy_logo_25percent_transparent.png){height="1em"} and the ![](/images/logo/W4M_long_logo.jpg){height="1em"} infrastructure!

The ![](/images/logo/W4E_long_logo.jpg){height="1em"} 2027 session (![](/images/W4E_icon.svg){height="1em"}2027) will take place in April 2027. 
During this one-week course (entirely in English), participants will learn how to use the ![](/images/W4M_icon.svg){height="1em"} infrastructure and analyze their own LC-MS, GC-MS, or NMR data.

For this new session, we continue with the acclaimed two-step format:

-   From 5th to 9th of April: online theoretical sessions (methods and tools). This session is *only accessible to person who will be present in Rennes for the onsite session.*
-   From April, 26th to 30th: tutoring on your own data, at [PNRB](https://formation-continue.univ-rennes.fr/pole-sciences-et-ingenierie) ([Rennes University](https://goo.gl/maps/9AN5Kq24mCNBiTwi7), France).

::: callout-important
The pre-registration is soon to be opened. As soon as it opens, you will find here the link to the pre-registration form.
:::

**Costs**: 1300€ for academic and 2500 € for private institution (to cover expenses for trainers, organization, materials and meals). A special discount of 100€ is offered for [RFMF](https://www.rfmf.fr/) members 2027.
